label: GO step near episode end (trial >=93) after an unrewarded visit to S1, with no reward two trials back
explanation: Very sparse feature. It fires only at GO, only in the last ~10 trials of the 100-trial episode (99.9% of mass at trials 90-99, none before trial 80), and only when the previous trial went unrewarded (100% of mass has prev_reward 0). Most activations follow an unrewarded visit to S1, usually after a1 with a common transition (prev_action a1: 83% of mass), and often come within a run of unrewarded trials. All activations have low model value (lowest value bin), and the model mostly picks a2 there (84% of mass), so the agent is often switching. Magnitude is largest on the GO where the agent switches to a2 after a losing streak on a1/S1. Never fires at D1 or D2, after a rewarded trial, or before trial 80. The predicate uses only observed variables and catches about 90% of activations and mass on dev, but precision is only about 0.17: many matching late-episode GO steps do not fire, so the trigger is not fully captured (possibly an internal time or low-value signal).
